Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design, consent, devices, BMS software/commissioning, 230V supply, trenching/penetrations, after-hours and above-3m work, per the fixed scope. band.basis: Sum of distinct components: 20mm surface PVC conduit (QV AKL 34.70-60.00/m, the two undisclosed 20mm rows), cable supply at ASI Auckland list $3.03/m +10% waste, and QV-rate build-ups for draw-in, 16 terminations, BMS cabinet interface, testing and scaffold hire, plus two small allowances (termination materials, sundries). Total for the 200m nominal quantity: approx $11,570 low / $19,680 high / $15,600 mid (57.86 / 98.39 / 78.13 $/m). Confidence is low because (a) containment, 60-70% of the total, rests on two identical-wording QV rows 73% apart and neither is described as heavy-duty orange, and (b) the labour-hour components plus the two allowances carry roughly a third of the total and the hours are QS estimates on a cited wage rate, not published fixed prices. No component is counted twice: conduit, cable material, and install/termination/testing labour are separately priced and the BMS cabinet interface is priced once, amortised over 200m.
